title: Create custom course materials
description: Transform handwritten equations and notes into formatted LaTeX documents without manual typesetting.
prompt:
I'm a math professor converting my handwritten integration notes into a professional course materials. I have:

* Handwritten notes with equations
* A typed outline of topics

Craft a professional-looking LaTeX document, resembling a published textbook page with colored boxes and precise equations, then convert it to PDF.
steps: Describe the task—specify handwritten notes and course objectives you want converted
Give Claude context by uploading handwritten notes, equations, or course materials
Claude creates a complete LaTeX document with professional formatting and compiled PDF
Follow up with prompts to enhance design, generate problem sets, or expand content
prerequisites: Upload handwritten notes (JPEG format) or class syllabus (PDF)
Extended Thinking enabled for complex mathematical content and LaTeX compilation
notes: Prompt required a second targeted extraction pass; first pass missed it. Follow-up prompts on page include adding margin notes/visual TOC and creating a homework assignment document with 15 integration by parts problems.
